items.title: Percy Humphrey Band: Percy Humphrey, Jim Robinson, Ernest Roubleau, Josiah Frazier Interview, 1972-02-29
items.q: when they first had what that band organized I wouldn't know. But I know Chinese, my cousin John and Simon was playing, Paul Bones and all of them.

ctx.x: But now, Celestan and Pirone's band, you played with them. Yeah, them guys were uniform. What were they dressed like?

Well, Pirone band, before I went in that group, they was, I think, now they're uniformed, I don't know if they were tuxedos when they were working at Tranchino. But when I went in the band, would have been 30, let me see, no, 28. They was wearing, we was wearing, you know, what you call like a gamel of striped pants, and sort of a pants, sort of a checkered coat like. Like pep and salt coat, with gamel of striped pants when we were working at Suburban Garden nightclub. And then a tuxedo band, well they always…
Well, did those high class people like the Lone Iron Blues and the barrel-ass?

items.title: Jim Robinson Interview, 1961-07-13
items.q: that's where I got Paul Bones and I got Kid Howard.

ctx.x: Willie, I went on a trip with Paul at Kennedy. Yeah.
With Paul Walburn. Yeah, I remember now.

items.title: Jim Robinson Interview, 1961-07-13
items.q: Paul and Howard and myself had six pieces

ctx.x: oh you had the band in charge yeah so you led bands before for a number of years now?

oh yeah six years now I didn't I didn't I know the men's I didn't have no trouble with the men's because the men know what they have to do they had a bit of trouble with them they had all good men's too Benny Turner Sidney Flusio Robert Davis Paul and Howard and myself had six pieces they didn't have a bit of trouble with the men's
you know I don't know anything about Robert Davis oh that's
